chunks.subject: AP Art History
chunks.title: Q3 — Visual Analysis (5 points)
chunks.content: AP Art History Q3, Visual Analysis, 5 points (Tasks A–E, 1 point each, independent). A: accurately describe ONE visual characteristic of the shown work. B: accurately describe ANOTHER visual characteristic. C: use specific visual evidence to explain how the artist creates a particular effect (e.g. a sense of space/depth). D: use specific visual evidence to explain how the artist guides the viewer. E: use specific visual or contextual evidence to explain a further point about the work. Describe = characteristics beyond naming; the explain tasks require specific visual evidence tied to the effect.

chunks.subject: AP Art History
chunks.title: Q3 exemplar — Sample 3A, 5/5
chunks.content: Q3 Visual Analysis scored 5/5 — earns both description points and all three explanation points, using specific visual evidence to tie each explanation to how the artist creates the effect and guides the viewer. Full-credit model.

chunks.subject: AP Art History
chunks.title: Q3 exemplar — Sample 3B, 3/5
chunks.content: Q3 scored 3/5 — earns the description points and one explanation, but two explanation tasks fall short (visual evidence not specific enough or not tied to the required effect). Typical mid-range profile.

chunks.subject: AP Art History
chunks.title: Q3 exemplar — Sample 3C, 2/5
chunks.content: Q3 scored 2/5 — earns roughly the two description points but not the explanation tasks, which require specific visual evidence linked to how the artist achieves an effect. Shows description is the accessible floor; explanation requires evidence-linked reasoning.
